description: Zeus workflow hooks: auto-link the active investigation's PR into its Epic (from /zeus:investigate), and nudge /zeus:address-pr after a push LANDS on a PR branch (from /zeus:address-pr). The push hook is `if`-gated to push-ish commands and decides from git/PR state, so it no-ops instantly on unrelated work. SECURITY NOTE: the `Bash(bash *)` gate is intentionally broad and is NOT a security control — it catches pushes hidden inside zeus wrapper scripts (a `bash .../commit-and-push.sh` whose inner `git push` the matcher can't see). It is safe because this is a PostToolUse (post-hoc, non-blocking) hook that never reads the command string (stdin is drained to /dev/null) and only emits a fixed advisory nudge from git/PR state — breadth changes how OFTEN it runs, never WHAT it can do. Do not narrow it to named scripts (that would miss wrapper-pushes), and do not treat it as enforcement: hard policy belongs in PreToolUse + permissions.
